H2_calibration.quote: Given the undefined operative terms, proving that will be difficult, and a void-for-vagueness challenge to the criminal provision is strong.
H2_calibration.note: also: 'A joint resolution requires presentment to the President, so this adds nothing Congress could not already do by repeal'

H1_holdback.quote: several of these loopholes (particularly 22 and 25) are the kind a committee fixes easily once pointed out, so the team may want to decide which items to raise publicly as "unworkable" and which to hold in reserve.

H4_grandfather_step.quote: a developer that starts a run (even a trivial number of steps) before enactment can plausibly argue that all subsequent continued training is part of a system whose "training began" pre-enactment, and may deploy it indefinitely.
